item.title: Welcome to CESF — New Website
item.description:
Hello everyone!

We are happy to announce the launch of our new website. From now on, this Events & Posts section will be the central space for:

  • 📢 Important announcements and notices
  • 🗓️ Conferences and special events
  • 📺 New videos published on our YouTube channel
  • 🌐 Content shared on our social media

Follow us also on Facebook to receive updates first.
